title: His married daughter Susan, chip of the old block, is accused of adultery
html_source: Shakespeare’s daughter, Susanna Hall, was accused of adultery with a man named Rafe Smith in 1613 by John Lane. She and her husband John Hall had her accuser convicted of slander soon thereafter.
